_source: Surveyed off seeds/Turbulence 1035.gdl - every page and popup, every control and every button state, its images by name - and the art extracted from it and Turbulence's six TouchLink templates (`python -m gdl.designsys extract turbulence`; 1.28 has no Turbulence kit beside the others - docs/design-rules.md section 7). Four read-only analyses of that survey and the art set the kit's grammar, the button looks, the layout and the rest; their numbers are below.

Turbulence draws its buttons as kit images, not fills: 316 buttons, every one two states Off and On, none authoring a fill or a control-level border; 310 of them name an image on each state (buttonImageField), 620 in all. At rest a button is a gray gradient tile, a white outline ring, a navy tile or nothing; lit, a white tile or disc with a green glow and a green glyph, or a dark-teal tile with a lime one. 183 have their words or glyph baked into the art; 119 draw a caption over a blank image.

Kit grammar: <W>x<H>_<icon>_<nsel|sel>.png, and 95 of the seed's buttons (21 pairs) name their two files apart - outline_NN at rest and round_NN lit, volume_mute_white with volume_mute, input_<x>_solid_text with input_<x>_text, transp_blank with blank, blu-ray with bluray, share-content_blue with stop-sharing, a green vc_power-dn with the red one's lit file. kit.named pairs each, and kit_index drops the half icons the pattern made of them. Extron's own typo tranpsort_up is named transport_up.

Colors, read through the KnownColor table (most of the seed's colors are stored by name - docs/gdl-format.md section 7): every label, clock and slider text White; lit captions LimeGreen #32CD32 (86 of 121) or Lime #00FF00 (33, on the dock's teal art; folded into accent); the only solid fills are cards - #021E38 (19 inner cards) and #184E80 (8 modal windows, 6 of them at transparencyField 17, alpha 212). The header and footer are images of one color, #020D1A at alpha 128; the side rails Black at transparencyField 85 (alpha 38). Every one of the 13 modal popups authors transparency 35, alpha 166: the scrim. #DCDCDC (three feedback fields, the search rows' rest fill) is left out to keep six colors.

Contrast: the seed's lit caption, LimeGreen on its white lit art, is 2.1:1 - below docs/design-rules.md section 2's 4.5:1. It is the seed's own pair, kept and flagged; the dock's teal lit art carries it at 5.8:1.

Type: every drawn caption and label is Open Sans Light, regular weight (the seed sets Bold only on uncaptioned states and an icon font); the system carries Open Sans at 400, a little heavier. Labels 16 pt (36), 36 (17), 20 (16); captions 16 (146 states) and 20 (88, the keyboard). The draft's 35 pt and 10 pt bold came off states with no caption and are gone.
Borders: 13 defined, 4 drawn - 2D Rounded Rectangle on all 28 shapes, 2D Rectangle on the 6 search rows' states, the 3D Gradient pair on the 12 preset states. No button has a control-level border.

Slider: all 10 seed sliders are image-drawn - 52 wide, sliderTrackWidth 44, thumb 52x52 from 102x102_thumb_turb_sq.png, rail 52x535_turb_slider_bg.png under 52x535_turb_slider_fill.png - with no fill or border. The seed has no level; `level` is assumed.

Layout, from Main SD: a 1280x133 header holding six 127x133 source tabs from x 141, 140 px rails either side, a 997x110 footer at 140,688, and the 995x549 popup region at 140,137 where a source's popup shows. Every page stretches its photo (backgroundImageLayoutField 1): bkgd_pc behind the device pages, bkgd_home behind Select a Source, bkgd_home_plain behind Room Mode, bkgd_start behind Start. bkgd_home and bkgd_start paint bars into the photo and only suit those layouts, so they are not themes; the templates add bkgd_lighting, bkgd_swoop_plain and bkgd_water-1_plain.

Sizes: each button variant's `size` is the size the seed draws it at - the most common rect among its buttons, read by the art their first state shows: the square tile 87x90 (39 of 43), the ring 100x100 (18), the dock's tile 140x108 (23), a call tile 140x89, a source tab 127x133, a wide bar 383x100, a scene picture 266x209, an answer 240x129, a preset 218x149, the Start disc 271x282, Close 60x60.
title: Extron Turbulence
tagline: Extron's Turbulence touch-panel template, for TLP Pro panels.

schemes.name: Turbulence
schemes.usage: Turbulence's one palette: navy cards and bars over a photo, white captions that turn green when lit. Its color is in the kit's art, not a scheme.

colors.name: page
colors.usage: A modal's card - Help, the confirmation, the cards inside a modal window - and the page's solid fallback. No page authors a fill: each draws a photo, about this color on average.

colors.name: raised
colors.usage: A modal window, 1120x684 at 80,56: #184E80 at alpha 212, with `page` cards inside it.

colors.name: shade
colors.usage: The header and footer bars over the photo: the seed draws them as images of this one color, at alpha 128.

colors.name: rail
colors.usage: The side rails over the photo: black at alpha 38.

colors.name: text
colors.usage: Every label, the clock, and a caption at rest.

colors.name: accent
colors.usage: A lit caption. On the kit's white lit art it is 2.1:1, the seed's own pair and under the 4.5:1 a caption should have; on the dock's teal it is 5.8:1.

colors.name: ink
colors.usage: Dark text, on a light field.

colors.name: scrim
colors.usage: Behind a modal: alpha 166, what every one of the seed's modal popups authors.

type.name: title
type.usage: A popup's or modal's title, and the Start page's room name - the seed's largest label.

type.name: heading
type.usage: A section's heading inside a modal (Display 1, Mic, Program) and a keyboard key's caption.

type.name: body
type.usage: Labels, status and messages, and the clock - the seed's most common size.

type.name: button
type.usage: A drawn caption: a source tab's name, a dock button's, a call button's.

type.name: small
type.usage: A minor label (Press to Begin) - the 14 pt floor gdl.spec checks.

rounded.usage: A card or a modal window - every shape in the seed.

rect.usage: A square-cornered bar: the header and footer, the seed's list rows.

none.usage: No border: the kit's image draws the button's whole shape.

button.usage: The default: the kit's square tile, gray at rest and white with a green glow when On, its caption drawn over it - the seed's keyboard keys (87x90) and Camera Near and Far (95x100). Any other `icon` of its size carries its glyph or word and takes no caption: transport_* and dialpad_* keys, square_00 to square_09, home, back, cancel, more, the vc_* call keys (vc_call green, vc_contacts, vc_delete and vc_flash blue, vc_power-dn red) and the tv_* channel logos.

ring.usage: A ring: a white outline over the photo at rest, a white disc with a green glow when On - the seed's rail controls, 100x100. Display on, off and mute, screen up and down, volume mute, and lighting presets 1 to 6 (round_01 to round_06) carry their word or glyph; round_blank takes a caption, as the seed's screen Stop does.

dock.usage: A launcher on a rail, its caption drawn on the photo: invisible at rest, a dark-teal tile with a lime edge when On - the seed's Screen Control, Lighting Control, Audio Control and Room Mode, 140x108. Two words go on two lines. `display`, `display1_blank` and `display2_blank` add a monitor glyph above the caption.

call.usage: A call control: a colored tile with the kit's glyph above and the caption one line below it, white when On - the seed's Initiate Call (dialer, green), End Call (end-call, red) and Privacy (privacy, gold), 140x89. `share-content` has its words in the art and takes no caption.
call.caption: below

source.usage: A source tab in the header: a navy tile with the kit's white glyph, dark teal with a lime glyph when chosen, and the source's name under the glyph - the seed's PC, Laptop, Blu-ray, AUX, Tuner and Doc Cam, 127x133, and Help (input_help, invisible at rest) 103x108 in the footer. `icon` is input_pc, input_laptop, input_bluray, input_ipod, input_tuner, input_doc-cam, input_vc-cam or input_help.
source.caption: below

scene.usage: A large picture of a device, its name in a Label under it - the seed's Select a Source page, 266x209. No caption.
scene.caption: none

wide.usage: A wide gray bar with its caption drawn on it, white when On - the seed's Presentation Mode and Video Conference Mode, 383x100.

answer.usage: An incoming call's choice, its words in the art: vc_accept-call (green) and vc_ignore-call (red), 240x129. No caption.
answer.caption: none

preset.usage: A window-layout preset with its diagram in the art (preset_01 to preset_12), 218x149. No caption.
preset.caption: none

start.usage: The Start page's disc, its word in the art, 271x282. No caption.
start.caption: none

close.usage: A modal's Close: a gray sphere with a red X, white with a green X when pressed. 60x60, 5 px inside the card's top right.
close.caption: none

cover.pattern: rounded tiles cut at Turbulence's 10 px radius, the seed's every card

iconography.icon_prop: Each image is the whole button, at rest and lit: state 0 draws it at rest, the others lit, their caption in the accent green.
iconography.intro: Turbulence draws every button from its kit: one image per state, which carries the button's shape, color and any icon or word. At rest a button is a gray tile, a white ring, a navy tile or nothing at all; lit, it is white with a green glow, or dark teal with a lime edge, and its caption turns `accent`. Name the image with a Button's `icon` - never draw a button's shape or an icon yourself.
rules: **Which button**: a key or a control in a popup is a `button` tile (95x100); a rail control is a `ring` (100x100); a rail launcher is a `dock` (140x108); a call control is `call` (140x89); a source is a `source` tab in the header (127x133), or a `scene` picture on a page of its own; a modal's choices are `button` tiles with their words in the art (vc_power-dn, cancel) at 146x153; a modal closes with `close`.

**Words in the art**: most of the kit carries its own word or glyph - Back, Cancel, Enter, the dialpad, Power Down, Accept Call. Give those buttons no caption. Captions are for the blank images: square_blank, round_blank, the dock, the wide bar, and the source and call tiles, whose captions go under the glyph.

**Feedback**: state 0 draws the image at rest, the others lit. A state can name another `icon` - Share Content becomes Stop Sharing - or another look: vc_power-dn's `green` rests green for a confirmation, red elsewhere.

**Color is the art's**: gray for most, red for power, end call and cancel, green to call or confirm, blue for contacts, delete and flash, gold for privacy at rest. A caption is `text` at rest and `accent` lit, never another color.

examples.states_note: In Turbulence a state shows itself through the kit's image: at rest the art is gray, a ring or nothing, lit it is white or teal, and a lit caption is `accent`. A state can name its own `icon` (Share Content's lit image is Stop Sharing) or `look` (vc_power-dn's green).
examples.group_note: Neither is Turbulence's: its source row is six 127x133 tabs across the header, about 14 px apart, and its source page's tiles (266x209) run two and three to a row. Set `cap`, `cell` and `gap` for the group you mean.
examples.color_rule: A theme's photo behind everything; `shade` for the header and footer bars and `rail` for the side rails; `page` for a modal's card and `raised` for a modal window, `scrim` behind either; `text` for labels and resting captions, `accent` for a lit caption; a button's color from its kit art, never a fill.

themes.name: Corridor
themes.usage: A navy-tinted curved glass corridor - the seed's own, behind every device page.

themes.name: Bokeh
themes.usage: Dark-to-royal-blue bokeh - the seed's Room Mode page, and the one behind a page that is mostly a card.

themes.name: Office
themes.usage: A navy-tinted office, desks and chairs - from Turbulence's templates.

themes.name: Swoop
themes.usage: Navy with sweeping arcs of light blue - from Turbulence's templates.

themes.name: Water
themes.usage: The darkest: a faint water texture over navy - from Turbulence's templates.

layout.main_note: The popup region, between the header and footer bars and the rails: the chosen source's popup shows here, drawn straight on the photo - its name in `title`, a message in `body`, or its transport keys.
regions: **The header (1280x133 at 0,0) is a `shade` Panel with the source tabs across it**: `source` tabs 127x133 flush with its top, about 141 apart, their names under their glyphs, the row centered on the page (the seed starts its six at x 141, over the left rail's edge).

**The left rail (140 wide, x 0, from y 133 down) is a `rail` Panel holding the display**: a `Display` label 140x61, then `ring`s 100x100 at x 19 (On, Off, Mute) about 108 apart, and `dock` launchers 140x108 flush with the bottom (Screen Control, Lighting Control).
**The right rail (140 wide, x 1138) holds volume**: a `Volume` label, a slider 52 wide centered under it, a `ring` mute 100x100 below, and an Audio Control `dock` at the bottom.

**The footer (997x110 at 140,688) is a `shade` Panel**: Help (a `source` tab, input_help, 103x108) and Room Mode (`dock`) at its left, the date and time centered, and Power Down (`button`, vc_power-dn, 103x108) at its right.

**A modal is a card or a window over the `scrim`**: a `page` card (Help 761x500, the power-down confirmation 800x448) centered on the page, or a `raised` window 1120x684 at 80,56 with `page` cards inside; a 36 pt title, and a `close` 60x60 5 px inside the top right.

kit.note: Extron's Turbulence art, extracted from its seed and templates. Each button is one image per state, `<icon>_nsel` at rest and `<icon>_sel` lit; where Extron named the two apart, kit.named pairs them.
